data.description: Close to Park | Well Maintained | Vacant
data.long_description:
Located in the peaceful community of The Springs, this well-maintained Type 4M townhouse offers a comfortable layout ideal for families. The property features a bright and spacious living and dining area, a functional kitchen, and a study room that can be used as a home office or additional storage space.

The outdoor area includes a landscaped garden, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The home is conveniently positioned close to community amenities, making it a great option for both end-users and investors.

Property Details:

Type 4M (Middle Unit)
2 Bedrooms
3 Bathrooms
Study Room
Size: 1,856.77 sq. ft.
Partial Upgrades
Spacious Living Area
Landscaped Garden
Built-in Wardrobes

Nearby Amenities:

Close to The Springs Souk
Walking distance to Park and Pool
Lakes and Green Spaces
Easy access to major roads and nearby schools.
